latest_release.name: v0.51.0
latest_release.body:
Welcome to the v0.51.0 release! In short, this release fixes a few small things by various contributors, some testing, and implements the beginnings of the name change from WTF to Tessera. See [this issue](https://github.com/wtfutil/wtf/issues/2186) for more info.

## Notable Changes

- Various fixes and added testing. Thanks to @Seanstoppable.
- Binaries are now produced under the new name `tessera`. 
- Fix WTF starting Docker by accident. Thanks @toby-bro.
- This might be the last minor release under the repository URL `github.com/wtfutil/wtf`. The project is moving to `github.com/linodians/tessera`. GitHub should hopefully redirect.
